Son of Yamanaka Mitsuyuki. On the day Shikanosuke is born, his father goes to fight the Mouri and dies in battle. Vowing to destroy the Mouri, Shikanosuke leaves home with Norimitsu, his father's sword. (Ep. 16)
Through his uncle, Tachihara Hisatsuna, he joins the Amago Army and faces the Mouri at Shiraga Castle. (Ep. 16)
After Gassan-Toda Castle falls to the Mouri, he welcomes Katsuhisa, an Amago orphan. Preparing to restore the Amago, he gains the backing of Oda Nobunaga. (Ep. 20)

A local lord of Bingo, based at Koyama Castle. He shelters and raises Watanabe Kayo, son of Watanabe Suguru, who was slain by Mouri Motonari.
In the Pacification of Aki and Bingo, he is on the Ouchi side. When the Amago invade, he puts himself under the command of Motonari, who rushes to his aid, and from then on serves with the Mouri Army. (Ep. 10)

en:
An Otomo retainer and son of Yoshihiro Akimasa.
In the Chikuzen Campaign, he confronts the Mouri Army alongside his father. (Ep. 19)

A local lord of Iwami, based at Sanbonmatsu Castle. Though he owes allegiance to the Ouchi, his family has feuded with the Sue since his ancestors' time. Angered by Sue Harukata's rebellion, he raises an army and asks the Mouri for reinforcements.
(Ep. 11)

A local lord of Iwami, based at Sanbonmatsu Castle. Though he owes allegiance to the Ouchi, his family has feuded with the Sue since his ancestors' time. Angered by Sue Harukata's rebellion, he raises an army and asks the Mouri for reinforcements. This leads the Mouri clan to break with Sue Harukata. (Ep. 11)

A local lord of Iwami, based at Sanbonmatsu Castle. Though he owes allegiance to the Ouchi, his family has feuded with the Sue since his ancestors' time. Angered by Sue Harukata's rebellion, he raises an army and asks the Mouri for reinforcements. This leads the Mouri clan to break with Sue Harukata. (Ep. 11)
In the Suo-Nagato Offensive, though on the Ouchi side, he cannot decide whether to advance or hold back, and waits to see how things go. But persuaded by the Mouri side, he then joins the Mouri Army. (Ep. 13)
